title: Choose the visual world — Prahari redesign
question: The roll assigned Approach Control Scope. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Approach Control Scope
options.thesis: The station scoped like inbound air traffic — density plotted as track and closure rate, not just a count.
options.viewport: Full-bleed circular scope as hero: zones plotted as contacts at a bearing/range where range maps to severity, rings marked at the five real density thresholds, a rotating sweep, predicted 90s trajectory drawn as an extrapolated vector past the rings it will cross, side rail as a radar-style contact log for the intervention feed.
options.risk: Sweep radar is a familiar security-dashboard trope; only lands if the ring-to-threshold mapping reads instantly, not decoratively.

raised.raise: Every hard numeric readout (density, countdown, response-time ms) renders as a tactile stacked-digit instrument, not flat sans numerals.
Panel chrome is flat, hard-edged planes under one fixed light source — no glassmorphism or soft blur, only true phosphor glow on the scope itself.

options.label: Mission Control Telemetry
options.lineage: ISRO / space-agency mission control telemetry rooms
options.thesis: The console reads like the room behind a launch broadcast — a mission clock counting the response, not the incident.
options.viewport: T+ mission clock as hero, flanked by live per-zone telemetry strips, a central 90-second forecast trajectory plot standing in for a launch trajectory graph.
options.risk: The safest-to-love direction here — instantly reads as ‘serious national infrastructure’ to a judge audience, but structurally less daring than the scope's spatial metaphor.

options.label: Nixie Instrument Bank
options.thesis: Every metric as a glowing physical digit stack — numbers you can watch tick, not just read.
options.case: Fuses well for raw numeric clarity on density/countdown/response-time figures, but a bank of independent tubes can't natively carry the zone-to-zone spatial flow this product's mechanism depends on — loses narrowly on product clarity against the scope's spatial read.
options.risk: Reads as a measuring instrument, not a system that visibly acts.

options.label: Glyph-Density Render
options.lineage: live scenes rendered as typewriter/glyph density
options.case: A life-safety console needs its exact density figures instantly legible; rendering the scene as ambiguous glyph art trades precision for texture — wrong tradeoff here.

options.label: Precisionist Industrial Plate
options.lineage: Precisionist industrial paintings — grain elevators, flat planes, raking light
options.case: A static composition of overlapping painted planes can't carry second-by-second live state changes this console needs.
options.kept: Hard-edged unmodulated planes under one raking light — no gradients, no soft glow, no glassmorphism.

options.label: Sneaker Archive Wall
options.case: Retail/collector object display has no mechanism-level relationship to a predictive safety system — the resonance is decorative only.

canonCard.label: Dark Ops Dashboard
canonCard.thesis: The neon-on-navy SaaS security dashboard this category ships by default, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Familiar three-pane admin layout: nav/status header, main panel, side feed — essentially the current build.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any other ‘AI security dashboard’ — the rut this reset exists to leave.
